(async()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const W=g.world; const F=g.floaters; const p=W.place('bend'); let spot=null; for(let r=0;r<200&&!spot;r+=8){ for(let k=0;k<24;k++){ const a=k/24*6.283; const x=p.x+Math.cos(a)*r, z=p.z+Math.sin(a)*r; const w=W.waterAt(x,z); if(w&&w.kind==='river'&&w.depth>1.0){ spot={x,z}; break; } } } g.player.place(p.x,p.z,0); F.locateRiver(p.x,p.z); F.filled=false; __fill(80); const alive=F.drifters.filter(d=>d.alive); const flakes=F.flakes.filter(f=>f.alive).length; const s=__shore(spot.x,spot.z,9); const r=await __look(spot.x,spot.z,W.waterAt(spot.x,spot.z).level,s.x,s.z,12,'river'); return r+': drifting '+alive.length+' ('+['drift-log','drift-pole','drift-spruce','drift-twig','drift-fireweed'].map(n=>n.split('-')[1]+' '+alive.filter(d=>d.K.name===n).length).join(', ')+'), petals and leaves '+flakes+', river d '+F.riverD.toFixed(0)})()

(async()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const F=g.floaters; let pick=null; for(const d of F.drifters){ if(!d.alive||(d.K.name!=='drift-log'&&d.K.name!=='drift-pole')) continue; const s=__wade(d.x,d.z,4); if(s&&(!pick||Math.hypot(d.x-s.x,d.z-s.z)<pick.dd)) pick={d,s,dd:Math.hypot(d.x-s.x,d.z-s.z)}; } if(!pick) return 'no log near a shore'; __freeze(true); const r=await __look(pick.d.x,pick.d.z,pick.d.level,pick.s.x,pick.s.z,12,pick.d.K.name); return r+' at '+pick.dd.toFixed(1)+' m'})()

(async()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const W=g.world; const F=g.floaters; const P=g.player.pos; let spot=null; for(let k=0;k<72&&!spot;k++){ const a=k/72*6.283; for(let r=1;r<14;r+=0.5){ const x=P.x+Math.cos(a)*r, z=P.z+Math.sin(a)*r; const w=W.waterAt(x,z); if(w&&w.kind==='river'&&w.depth>0.35&&w.depth<0.9){ const s=__wade(x,z,2.6,0.2); if(s){ spot={x,z,w,s}; break; } } } } if(!spot) return 'no spot for the branch view'; const put=(name,dx,dz,yaw)=>{ const d=F.drifters.find(q=>q.K.name===name&&q.alive); if(!d) return; d.x=spot.x+dx; d.z=spot.z+dz; d.level=spot.w.level; d.yaw=yaw; d.fade=1; d.dying=false; }; __freeze(false); put('drift-spruce',0,0,0.6); put('drift-twig',1.2,0.9,2.2); put('drift-fireweed',-0.9,1.0,1.1); const save=F.drifters.map(d=>({d,fx:d.fx,fz:d.fz})); for(const d of F.drifters){ d.fx=0; d.fz=0; d.t=99; } F.update(0.016); __freeze(true); const r=await __look(spot.x,spot.z,spot.w.level,spot.s.x,spot.s.z,12,'branches'); return r+' at '+Math.hypot(spot.x-spot.s.x,spot.z-spot.s.z).toFixed(1)+' m'})()

(async()=>{const g=__rhf.game; __freeze(false); const W=g.world; const F=g.floaters; const L=W.lakes.find(l=>l.tint!=='glacial'); const m=F.padMesh; const mm=new (m.matrix.constructor)(); let best=null; for(let i=0;i<m.count;i+=5){ m.getMatrixAt(i,mm); const x=mm.elements[12], z=mm.elements[14]; let n=0; const q=new (m.matrix.constructor)(); for(let j=Math.max(0,i-40);j<Math.min(m.count,i+40);j++){ m.getMatrixAt(j,q); if(Math.hypot(q.elements[12]-x,q.elements[14]-z)<4) n++; } if(!best||n>best.n) best={x,z,n}; } let spot=null; for(let k=0;k<32;k++){ const a=k/32*6.283; const x=best.x+Math.cos(a)*5, z=best.z+Math.sin(a)*5; const w=W.waterAt(x,z); if(w&&w.depth<0.9){ spot={x,z}; break; } } if(!spot) return 'no wading spot'; g.player.place(spot.x,spot.z,0); __fill(40); __freeze(true); const r=await __look(best.x,best.z,L.level,spot.x,spot.z,12,'lilies'); return r+': '+best.n+' pads within 4 m, petals '+F.flakes.filter(f=>f.alive).length})()

(async()=>{const g=__rhf.game; __freeze(false); const W=g.world; const F=g.floaters; const L=F.glacierLake; let best=null; for(const f of F.floes){ const s=__shore(f.x,f.z,14); if(s&&(!best||f.size>best.f.size)) best={f,s}; } if(!best) return 'no floe view'; g.player.place(best.s.x,best.s.z,0); __fill(5); const r=await __look(best.f.x,best.f.z,L.level,best.s.x,best.s.z,15,'floes'); return r+', biggest visible floe '+best.f.size.toFixed(1)+' m'})()
